Chapter 7082: I’M Not A Chick

Chapter 7082: I’m Not A Chick

“We’re starting.” Li Qiye said solemnly.

“Back to the source!” He shouted.

Li Qiye took a deep breath and placed his palm on the old man’s chest, pushing forward. Although nothing flashy occurred, it had enough power to destroy a major world.

“Bam!” The old man was sent flying.

No, he remained standing but there was an identical astral form being pushed out, something resembling his soul.

Li Qiye immediately grabbed the astral form and placed it in the light source.

“Return and find yourself.” He shouted and fused the two - a feat forbidden by the high heaven. After all, the old man’s soul and source have been sealed entirely by the high heaven.

The soul dispersed into particle strings and fused perfectly with the source. Now, the latter looked perfect and complete.

On the contrary, his body became ethereal, seemingly melting like snow.

“Open!” Li Qiye shouted, reversing time and space back to the very beginning.

There existed a blinding light, capable of piercing the eyes of celestial immortals. This was before the formation of heaven and earth. The nine major worlds have yet to form.

Li Qiye’s eyes remained open to look at the incoming explosion. This was the light of creation, releasing endless mysteries and dao sources.

The most dreadful of them all was the high heaven’s will, something more potent than the enforcer’s slash. This will contained everything here for an eternity.

“Open!” Li Qiye grabbed the will, causing it to turn into the sharpest spear in retaliation.

This spear could make Dusk and Heavenfall tremble to the core, shattering their battle spirit. Alas, Li Qiye caught it with both hands before it could pierce his chest and shattered it.

“Buzz.” The suppressed mysteries and dao laws became brighter, capable of traveling across the river of time into the future.

“So this is Splendor’s ultimate form.” Li Qiye said.

Only such a light could shake the high heaven. The legends regarding Mang were inaccurate.

“Buzz.” The light converged into the form of an old man. He opened his eyes, revealing their immense profundities.

“Return, leaves to roots.” He said gently, like a mother whispering to her child.

The old man standing behind Li Qiye, on the other hand, looked to be on the verge of dispersing.

“Bastard, go die!” He shouted.

The meditating old man wasn’t angry, having an expression of returning to a warm, candle-lit home after a long journey.

“I want to die but still alive...” He said.

The old man came over and sat down, staring at Li Qiye.

“It’s time.” Li Qiye sighed.

He closed his eyes and the two old men fused into one - a more radiant being.

“Incredible, a mortal reaching this level, truly unimaginable.” The new being stared at Li Qiye and said.

“No need to imagine, you have my memories now.” Li Qiye sat down and said.

“Heaven and earth are like a chick, you are as well.” He said after observing Li Qiye.

“I’m not since there can’t be two. Moreover, there’s another meaning to chick that is rather unsavory, don’t get it mixed up.” Li Qiye joked. [1]

“I’m old, I can’t keep up with today’s pace.” He said.

“You don’t have an age to speak of.” Li Qiye said.

“Right, but when I saw you, I felt old and surpassed.” He said.

“Surpassed is correct.” Li Qiye smiled.

“When I was born, I never thought a miracle such as yourself would happen.” He said.

“The world belongs to all living beings, they’re the miracles, not the high heaven or the dao mysteries that are just the norm.” Li Qiye said.

1. Slang for prostitute ☜
